title: Desk market wrap 11/6
summary: Jobs print came in stronger and the dollar firmed; the AI complex faded after the open. NYAD stays in a sell signal, VIX held over 20, and SPY is trying to hold the rising 200-day into next week's inflation prints. Size put sellers were active in first-quarter 2027 in beaten-up quality names.

title: Desk open wrap 11/6
summary: Futures steadied after Thursday's plunge with jobs in focus; VIX still elevated after the spike. Tech led an early snapback while Europe and Asia sold off on AI-spend and valuation worries.
